decisions.summary: The selected view calls the deciding model through RecordsEngine.converse before returning its completion.
The served view preserves the operator prompt in its system message; selecting user-scoped evidence does not itself lose applicable trusted instructions.
No host semantic comparison selects between parseable deciding replies on this branch; the one-time reply check passes its next valid reply through.
Default no-kind dated-email view calculates the last email on the requested day and directs the model to copy that host-selected value into ANSWER, rather than weigh an advisory candidate.
The inspected dated-contact branch supplies no copied generator input construction; other view branches were not fully resolved for I5.
The challenged dated-email path uses model prose, but the other served tool paths were not fully reviewed for execution fidelity.
No tool-planning finding is established by the dated-email branch; other served catalog and executor gates remain outside this narrow cause adjudication.
No evaluation-identity branch is proven by the dated-contact evidence; the wider served path has not been fully reviewed for I8.
